item.description:
Deadline: 2027-11-14 12:00
Institution: Politecnico MILANO, Milan
Field: Civil engineering and architecture / 08/CEAR-07 Tecnica delle costruzioni

The project focuses on the development and validation of innovative, low-cost, large-scale, and automated technologies for collecting and utilizing information related to the structural health of bridges in support of decision relevnt to seismic performance management. The work will be carried out within the framework of the BRIDGITISE project (Doctoral Network on Bridge Digitalised Integrity Management), ID 101119554, funded by the European Commission under the HORIZON TMA MSCA Doctoral Networks – Industrial Doctorates program.

item.title: Contratto di ricerca: Developement of numerical methods for landslide analysis (Univ. della CALABRIA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-23 23:59
Institution: Univ. della CALABRIA, Rende (Cs)
Field: Civil engineering and architecture / 08/CEAR-05 Geotecnica

The research project aims to develop scientific and technical-operational activities within the framework of technology transfer. Specifically, it focuses on developing and validating advanced methodologies for the predictive analysis of landslides. The scientific activity will address the entire evolutionary process of landslides, from the pre-failure to the post-failure phase, through the implementation of variable-complexity methodologies. item.title: Contratto di ricerca: Prg. Interreg - Trees4ProLands - Trees Stability Monitoring for Protection of Urban and Forest Landscapes - 2026_CDR_DICA_10 (Politecnico MILANO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-21 12:00
Institution: Politecnico MILANO, Milan
Field: Civil engineering and architecture / 08/CEAR-05 Geotecnica

Trees are complex living “structures” that are exposed to increasingly intense weather events due to ongoing climate change. In urban areas, falling trees pose a real risk to property, structures, infrastructure, and people. In forested areas, the protection of monumental trees and, more generally, the tree heritage involves the conservation of biomass and biodiversity, the reduction of erosion, and the mitigation of landslide risk. The Trees4ProLands project aims to enhance current techniques (for assessing tree stability, the hydrological balance, and ecosystem services) with cutting-edge engineering and scientific knowledge.

item.title: Contratto di ricerca: Integration of exposure to natural radioactivity into LCA of construction materials with NORM - 2026_CDR_DICA_9 (Politecnico MILANO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-21 12:00
Institution: Politecnico MILANO, Milan
Field: Civil engineering and architecture / 08/CEAR-07 Tecnica delle costruzioni

The LCA4NORM project aims to fully integrate Naturally Occurring Radioactive Material (NORM) hazards into Life Cycle Assessment (LCA). Closely tied to a holistic NORM management strategy, it seeks to embed NORM considerations into the LCA methodology, which evaluates environmental impacts across a product’s entire life cycle. For the first time, the project will include radioactivity assessment at all stages, acknowledging its interaction with other environmental factors rather than treating it as an isolated issue.
